title: fix(app-shell): Position preview lists the permission sets a position declares
body:
Fixes #13304
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`PositionPreview` read only `name` / `label` / `description` and always rendered "Positions don't grant data access on their own. Bind NAME to one or more Permission Sets…", even for a position whose draft declares `permissionSets` (ADR-0131 D4). Measured in the browser on HotCRM (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2229): Setup, Positions, `service_manager`.

- When the draft's `permissionSets` is a non-empty array, the callout reads "This position grants access through these **Permission Sets**:" and lists each set by machine name (as a code span), in declared order, followed by the record-visibility sentence (business-unit tree and sharing rules, not the position).
- The existing "grants nothing on its own / bind it" note renders only when the draft declares none: absent, `[]`, or not an array. Non-string entries in the array are skipped.
- Draft only: no fetch for set labels. No sibling preview resolves set labels from its props (`MetadataPreviewProps` carries no catalogue); `AgentPreview` lists `permissions` by name the same way.
- Two new rows, en and zh (the only locale blocks carrying `engine.positionPreview.*`): `engine.positionPreview.grantsVia` (reuses `engine.positionPreview.permissionSets` for the noun) and `engine.positionPreview.visibility`.
- Header comment rewritten: the position carries `permissionSets` (ADR-0131 D4) and the preview shows them.

## Tests

- New `PositionPreview.permissionSets-13304.test.tsx`: (a) `['service_agent', 'support_viewer']` lists both names in order and the "grants nothing" note is absent; (b) CONTROL: no `permissionSets` and `[]` render the existing note; (c) a string value is treated as none.
- `adminPreviews.i18n-10862-s2.test.tsx` gains an en/zh case for the declared branch (each new row renders, zh rows are real zh rows).
- Targeted vitest (`--maxWorkers=1`, under the shared lock): 2 files, 44 tests passed.
- Ablation (committed fix first; mutation via `ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `{permissionSets.length > 0 ? (` replaced by `{false ? (`, anchor count 1 to 0, blob `ce8a2934` to `8376b3a0`): (a) went red, the three control/none cases stayed green (1 failed, 3 passed). Restore proven by blob hash: file blob after restore equals the HEAD blob `ce8a29347417`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` closure build (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`) then `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` plus `tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 4 changed source/test files: 0 errors, 0 warnings (4 files per `--format json`; the eslint config enables no type-aware linting, so the diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict).
- Gates, each exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`. `check:spec-floors` exit 1 (no-artifact: the workspace was not fully built; recorded, not fixed, as on main).
- Declared to CI: the full `packages/app-shell/` test directory (not run locally).
